newsitem.title: CHINA: Britain's AMEC, Chinese firm in reclamation project.
newsitem.headline: Britain's AMEC, Chinese firm in reclamation project.

text.p: A land construction company in southern China has signed a letter of intent with Britian's AMEC International Construction Ltd to jointly launch a land reclamation project, company officials said on Monday.

The project with investment of 1.2 billion yuan ($140 million) was to protect the shore and reclaim land at Xinbu island near Haikou, capital of the southern province of Hainan, an official of Haikou Xinbu Island Development and Construction General Company told Reuters by telephone.
The project could help Haikou city reclaim 3.07 square km of land, the official said but give no further details.
